title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the stored-item conversion read out of protocol.ts into protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts (#25467 cut 23)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 23 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`), the first after the release pause (restart recorded on #25467 once 18.2.0 shipped). Cuts 1–22 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404 and #26449. The claim is `6439185861`. It takes the cut 23 proposal of the cut 22 report (`6433520681`). Both members passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and both moved unedited.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts` (#23050 shape B):

- `convertStoredItemDetailed`: the ADR-0087 conversion chain over a stored body, with its notices and TODOs handed back. `migrateStoredMetadata` reports these per row (#4327, #17321, #25279).
- `convertStoredItem`: the read every stored row goes through. It warns once per conversion, row and process, and fills a page's declared `type` default (#20101).

`protocol.ts` loses 17 net lines (29,182 to 29,165). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `f9867020c6` after the restart. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `1d1579ed11` and two merges of `main`: `6d09a4555e`, and `0741a0f66b`, which was made because `dispatch-gates` itself had changed on `main` (scripts and docs only). Neither merge touches a file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`. The package's `src/` tree is `c7cd94f5` at the move commit and at both merges.

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened, against the merged head `0741a0f66b`: of the 15 open PRs, **none edits `protocol.ts`**, and none names either member, `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` or `applyConversionsToStoredItem`. One touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` test files: **#26337** (3 files). Its `git merge-tree` is clean against this head and against `origin/main` alone. No open PR edits the new module.

`main` moved one commit after the last merge: #26599 (`dbf7e04adf`), the spec retirement of conversion kits at or below 16.x. It does not touch `protocol.ts`. It does edit seven `protocol.*stored*`/conversion test files in this package and the spec conversion chain that `applyConversionsToStoredItem` runs. Its `git merge-tree` with this head is clean. This cut moves the call to that chain unedited, so the PR's merge ref runs #26599's tests against the moved code. Its one stale gate file (`scripts/check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors.mjs`) is not among this cut's 46 derived commands, so `main` was not merged a third time.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

Both members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** Neither body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut: `82 read seam(s)` and an identical list once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings are under "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `convertStoredItem` | `:6416` | private | 13 | 138 |
| `convertStoredItemDetailed` | `:6452` | private | 15 | 187 |

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–22 apply it)

- **The class keeps both members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 23]`.
- **`convertStoredItemDetailed` reads no member.** This was measured by an AST walk over `this` accesses, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped, and bare `this` checked. So its stub is a plain call, `return convertStoredItemDetailed(type, data, onNotice, knownDatasources);`, as cuts 16 and 21 did. The class signature keeps the `ConversionNotice`/`ConversionTodoNotice` types, so those type imports stay in `protocol.ts`.
- **`convertStoredItem` reads two members.** `StoredItemConversionHost` types each as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['…']`). The function types its `this` as their `Pick`, and the stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof convertStoredItem>`.
  - `convertStoredItemDetailed` is handed over as a closure, so the body's call still reaches the class method and, through its stub, the moved function.
  - `storedConversionWarned` is a private FIELD, a `Set<string>`, so it is handed over as a getter. The body only calls `.has` and `.add` on it, inside the `onNotice` arrow, and never reassigns it. So the warn-once set it reads and adds to is the protocol's own, shared with every other read, exactly as before.
  - The getter is the same hand-over cut 20 used for the `getServicesRegistry` field.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** The `this.convertStoredItem(` sites at `:7277`, `:9812`, `:10857`, `:10922`, `:11498`, `:18885`, `:25342`, `:25576` and `:28359` (base) do not change. Neither does the cut 16 closure that hands it to `storedOverlayEntries` (`:10211`), or the remaining `this.convertStoredItemDetailed(` site (`:21925`).

## Module-level declarations, by reader

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` | non-exported function, `:2263` | yes (the save door, `:20924`) | gains `export` in place; the new module imports it from `./protocol.js` |
| `applyConversionsToStoredItem` | the `@objectstack/spec` import, `:170` | **none** | **dropped from that import** (its last reader moved); the new module imports it from `@objectstack/spec` |
| `ConversionNotice`, `ConversionTodoNotice` | type imports on the same line | yes (both stubs' declared signatures) | stay; the new module imports them as types from there too |
| `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` | the `@objectstack/spec/shared` import | yes (58) | stays; imported from there too |

`index.ts` names its exports one by one, so the in-place `export` does not reach the published surface.

**One stale prose reference, disclosed and not edited.** The `[commit ece4dad31]` emitted-specifier comment under the imports (`:172`) says the file imports the `@objectstack/spec` root "for `applyConversionsToStoredItem` above". The root import stays, for `applyConversionsToFlow` and the two notice types, so the pin it explains still holds. The `.d.ts` readings below confirm that nothing about the emitted declarations moved. Editing that sentence is not move-only, so this PR leaves it for a later edit.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `82 read seam(s)` at both ends. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (158 lines, and no entry changes file). Neither body has a `try`. `convertStoredItem`'s `console.warn` sits in an `onNotice` callback, not a `catch`, so the log-level rule does not grade it. On the merged tree the verdict still reads `82 read seam(s)`.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut.**

Base `f9867020c6` and head `1d1579ed11` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `dd66cd91652093f2a0ce9a3b990290291bf3bcc40379d196a1bbe897c1ec43d7` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `f4f602c840264aa052ee96788778479ba2ddccbd68199ad68f4419ff564f6ccd` at both ends, 778,346 bytes. **Raw identity holds.** The emitted specifiers did not move with the import change.
- **Again on the merged tree** `6d09a4555e` (closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 116/116): the same raw and normalised sha256, and the same `index.js`/`index.cjs` hashes, as the pre-merge head. The second merge changed no package and no build input.
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `3aedf79b4657c927…` at base and `8cc705b2d0a6a59b…` at head (`index.cjs` `b1d7383e753c4e1a…` → `8af96d570232787c…`).
  - `convertStoredItem.call(host` occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
  - `function convertStoredItem(` goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `convertStoredItem` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `a39e3a50ba0baab4…` (normalised `573d8a0a1d7bb1ca…`, which differs from the bar's `dd66cd91…`) and print `convertStoredItem(type: string, data: unknown): unknown;`. So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. None of the moved functions, `StoredItemConversionHost` or `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `f9867020c6` against the head module:

```
convertStoredItem: base tokens 138, head tokens 138, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
convertStoredItemDetailed: base tokens 187, head tokens 187, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=325 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=299 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=251 head=252 byte-identical=249
```

The two top-level statements that are not byte-identical are the `@objectstack/spec` import, which lost `applyConversionsToStoredItem`, and `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault`, which gained `export`. Nothing else changed in either.

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of the head module:

```
MUTATED … "if (singular === 'flow')" -> "if (singular !== 'flow')"
convertStoredItem: base tokens 138, head tokens 138, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
convertStoredItemDetailed: base tokens 187, head tokens 187, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
MUTATED … "storedConversionWarned.has(key)" -> "storedConversionWarned.add(key)"
convertStoredItem: base tokens 138, head tokens 138, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
convertStoredItemDetailed: base tokens 187, head tokens 187, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 299 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Both stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** Of the 251 base statements, 249 are byte-identical, leading comments included; the other two are the import and the `export` above. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +111 / −30 over 2 files, 141 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 150–200). `protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts` has 98 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

The tests and scripts that read `protocol.ts` by path (the files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`) were grepped for both member names and for the bodies' text: `storedConversionWarned`, `applyConversionsToStoredItem`, `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault`, `carries a pre-protocol shape`. So were the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path: none reads the moved bodies.** Of the 33 such files, the one textual hit is the gitignored, build-written `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, which names `applyConversionsToStoredItem` (a `@objectstack/spec` export) in its migration entries and does not read `protocol.ts`.
- **Behaviour through the class method, no edit owed.** `protocol.flow-canonicalizer.test.ts` and `metadata-diagnostics.union-issues.test.ts` (metadata-protocol) and `view-overlay-owner-hidden-retirement.test.ts` (spec) name `convertStoredItem` in comments only, and drive the read through the protocol. The first two pass at both ends, in the package suite.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at either member. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). Both still quote lines that moved to a seam module. `check:liveness` checks only that the `#symbol` is named in the file, and both stubs keep it. Re-pointing them is a `packages/spec/**` edit, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends.
  - The decision-letter count is unchanged at 1,881. The moved bodies carry no ADR letter; the docblocks that cite ADR-0087 D2 stay on the stubs.
  - The citation count goes 59,819 → 59,821 and the file count 8,353 → 8,354, from the new module's header.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13883 → 13866, 13908 → 13891).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,773 at base and 3,775 at head. The +2 are the new file and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–22.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `f9867020c6`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head and on the merged tree.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `f9867020c6`: 21,595 tests (21,576 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 272 files.
  - Head `1d1579ed11`: 21,595 tests (21,576 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 272 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `f9867020c6` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `6d09a4555e` gives the same 21,595 tests, per test identical to the pre-merge head (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK. 1 anchored file is in the change set, 29 anchors were judged, and 0 were lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 141 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from `0741a0f66b`, with no stale-tree warning, and all 46 exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.
  - The same 46 also exited 0 on `6d09a4555e`, after the full `pnpm build` (116/116).
  - That derivation flagged `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` itself as stale against `main`, so `main` was merged again, and the derivation and every gate re-run.
- `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` on `0741a0f66b`: `82 read seam(s)`.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21). A member named in a `protocol.ts` read-seam entry of `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list`, as the guarded wrapper or the guarding member, stays until the gate follows imported wrappers or a ruling accepts the loss. The census trial on this base, over 50 members, measured the same census-negative set as cut 22's trial: `findEnvironmentRows` 66, `packagelessAddress` 78, `findServedOverlayRow` 79, and `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees` 81. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
